name: Longest Field Goal Made
description: The longest successful field goal attempt made by the player during the game, measured in yards.

name: Field Goals Attempted
description: The total number of field goal attempts made by the player during the game.

name: Field Goals Blocked
description: The total number of field goal attempts that were blocked by the player during the game.

name: Field Goals Made
description: The total number of successful field goals made by the player during the game.

name: Fumble Return Touchdowns
description: The total number of touchdowns scored by the player as a result of returning a fumble recovery.

name: Fumble Return Yards
description: The total number of yards gained by the player when returning a fumble recovery.

name: Fumbles Forced
description: The total number of fumbles caused by the player during the game.

name: Fumbles Lost
description: The total number of fumbles lost by the player during the game.

name: Fumbles Recovered
description: The total number of fumbles recovered by the player during the game.

name: Longest Interception Return
description: The longest distance, in yards, the player returned an interception during the game.

name: Interception Return Yards
description: The total number of yards gained by the player when returning an interception.

name: Interception Touchdowns
description: The total number of touchdowns scored by the player as a result of returning an interception.

name: Kickoffs Gross Yards
description: The total number of yards covered by all kickoffs made by the player during the game.

name: Kickoffs Out of Bounds
description: The total number of kickoffs that went out of bounds during the game.

name: Total Kickoffs
description: The total number of kickoffs made by the player during the game.

name: Kickoffs Touchbacks
description: The total number of kickoffs that resulted in touchbacks during the game.

name: Longest Kick Return
description: The longest distance, in yards, the player returned a kickoff during the game.

name: Total Kick Returns
description: The total number of kickoffs returned by the player during the game.

name: Kick Return Touchdowns
description: The total number of touchdowns scored by the player as a result of returning a kickoff.

name: Kick Return Yards
description: The total number of yards gained by the player when returning a kickoff.

name: Kicks Blocked By
description: The total number of kicks (field goals or extra points) blocked by the player during the game.

name: Pass Breakups
description: The total number of passes defended by the player during the game, resulting in an incomplete pass.

name: Passing Attempts
description: The total number of times the player has attempted to throw a forward pass during the game.

name: Passing Completions
description: The total number of successful forward passes completed by the player during the game.

name: Intercepted Passes
description: The total number of forward passes thrown by the player that were intercepted by the opposing team during the game.

name: Longest Pass Completion
description: The longest distance, in yards, of a completed forward pass thrown by the player during the game.

name: Passing Sacks
description: The total number of times the player was sacked while attempting a forward pass during the game.

name: Passing Touchdowns
description: The total number of touchdowns scored by the player through completed forward passes during the game.

name: Passing Yards
description: The total number of yards gained by the player through completed forward passes during the game.

name: Passing Yards Lost to Sacks
description: The total number of yards lost by the player due to sacks while attempting forward passes during the game. Default to this if the query is "Passing yards sacked" or "Passes yards sacked"

name: Pass Interceptions
description: The total number of times the player intercepted a forward pass thrown by the opposing team during the game.

name: Quarterback Hurries
description: The total number of times the player pressured the opposing quarterback, causing them to hurry their throw, during the game.

name: PAT Kicks Attempted
description: The total number of point-after-touchdown (PAT) kicks attempted by the player during the game.

name: PAT Kicks Made
description: The total number of successful point-after-touchdown (PAT) kicks made by the player during the game.

name: PAT Pass Attempts
description: The total number of point-after-touchdown (PAT) pass attempts made by the player during the game.

name: PAT Passes Completed
description: The total number of successful point-after-touchdown (PAT) passes completed by the player during the game.

name: PAT Rush Attempts
description: The total number of point-after-touchdown (PAT) rush attempts made by the player during the game.

name: PAT Rushes
description: The total number of successful point-after-touchdown (PAT) rushes made by the player during the game.

name: Punt Returns
description: The total number of punts returned by the player during the game.

name: Longest Punt Return
description: The longest distance, in yards, the player returned a punt during the game.

name: Punt Return Touchdowns
description: The total number of touchdowns scored by the player as a result of returning a punt during the game.

name: Punt Return Yards
description: The total number of yards gained by the player when returning a punt during the game.

name: Punts
description: The total number of punts executed by the player during the game.

name: Punts Over 50 Yards
description: The total number of punts kicked by the player that traveled over 50 yards during the game.

name: Punts Blocked
description: The total number of punts that were blocked by the opposing team during the game.

name: Punts Fair Caught
description: The total number of punts that were caught by the receiving team without attempting to advance the ball (fair catch) during the game.

name: Punts Inside 20 Yards
description: The total number of punts that were downed inside the opponent's 20-yard line during the game.

name: Longest Punt
description: The longest distance, in yards, the player punted the ball during the game.

name: Punts Touchbacks
description: The total number of punts that resulted in the ball being downed in the end zone, resulting in a touchback during the game.

name: Punting Yards
description: The total number of yards covered by all punts executed by the player during the game.

name: Receptions
description: The total number of passes caught by the player during the game.

name: Longest Reception
description: The longest distance, in yards, the player caught a pass during the game.

name: Reception Touchdowns
description: Also called receiving touchdowns. The total number of touchdowns scored by the player through caught passes during the game.  Also called "Receiving Touchdowns"

name: Reception Yards
description: Yards gained by a receiver on a play in which they successfully catch a pass, including the distance the ball was thrown and any additional yardage gained after the catch. Also called "Receiving Yards"

name: Rushing Attempts
description: The total number of times the player carried the ball during the game.

name: Longest Rush
description: The longest distance, in yards, the player advanced the ball on a rushing attempt during the game.

name: Rushing Touchdowns
description: The total number of touchdowns scored by the player through rushing attempts during the game.

name: Rushing Yards Gained
description: The total number of yards gained by the player through rushing attempts during the game.

name: Rushing Yards Lost
description: The total number of yards lost by the player due to negative rushing plays during the game.

name: Net Rushing Yards
description: Should be returned by default if the search is "Rushing Yards". The total number of yards gained by the player through rushing attempts, adjusted for any yards lost due to negative rushing plays during the game.

name: Assisted Sacks
description: The total number of sacks in which the player participated, sharing the responsibility with one or more teammates during the game.

name: Total Sacks
description: The total number of times the player successfully tackled the opposing quarterback behind the line of scrimmage, resulting in a loss of yards during the game.

name: Unassisted Sacks
description: The total number of sacks in which the player was solely responsible for tackling the opposing quarterback behind the line of scrimmage during the game.

name: Sack Yards
description: The total number of yards lost by the opposing team due to sacks made by the player during the game.

name: Assisted Tackles
description: The total number of tackles in which the player participated, sharing the responsibility with one or more teammates during the game.

name: Assisted Tackles for Loss
description: The total number of tackles for loss in which the player participated, sharing the responsibility with one or more teammates during the game.

name: Solo Tackles for Loss
description: The total number of tackles for loss in which the player was solely responsible for stopping the opposing player behind the line of scrimmage during the game.

name: Total Tackles for Loss
description: The total number of tackles for loss made by the player during the game, including both solo and assisted tackles.

name: Solo Tackles
description: The total number of tackles in which the player was solely responsible for stopping the opposing player during the game.

name: Total Tackles
description: The total number of tackles made by the player during the game, including both solo and assisted tackles.

name: Tackles Yards
description: The total number of yards lost by the opposing team due to tackles made by the player during the game.

name: Touchdowns Scored
description: The total number of touchdowns scored by the player during the game, including rushing, receiving, and defensive touchdowns.

name: Passing Yards Per Attempt
description: The average number of yards gained per passing attempt by the player.

name: Pass Completion Percentage
description: The percentage of pass attempts completed by the player.

name: Average Rushing Yards
description: The average number of net yards gained per rushing attempt by the player.

name: Average Yards per Reception
description: The average number of yards gained per reception by the player.

name: Takeaways
description: The number of times the player recovered a fumble or intercepted a pass.

name: Field Goal Percentage
description: The percentage of field goal attempts successfully made by the player.

name: Kickoffs Returned
description: The number of kickoffs returned by the player.

name: Average Punt Return Yards
description: The average number of yards gained per punt return by the player.

name: Net Kickoff Yards
description: The total net yards gained on kickoffs by the special teams unit.

name: Average Punt Yards
description: The average number of yards per punt made by the player.

name: Total Offensive Yards
description: The total number of yards gained by the player on offense.

name: All-Purpose Yards
description: The total yards gained by the player from rushing, receiving, and returns.

name: Turnovers Committed
description: The number of times the player turned the ball over, via fumble or interception.
